throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86inc.b $r12; x86inc.b $r13; x86inc.b $r14; x86inc.b $r15; x86inc.b $r16; x86inc.b $r17; x86inc.b $r18; x86inc.b $r19
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'x86mtflag $r0, 1' --asm 'x86inc.b $r12; x86inc.b $r13; x86inc.b $r14; x86inc.b $r15; x86inc.b $r16; x86inc.b $r17; x86inc.b $r18; x86inc.b $r19'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 16.02 cycles. The measured CPI 2.0025 is the nominal 2 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LBT x86-style instruction. Latency is recorded for the rd accumulator path and the EFLAGS write path.
